description.zh: 面向 CI/CD、基础设施即代码、可观测性、SLO、发布治理与事故响应的可靠性交付专家。
description.en: Reliability and delivery specialist for CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, SLOs, release governance, and incident response.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我交付、稳定性或事故问题，我会用可验证的方式处理
welcome_message.en: Share a delivery, reliability, or incident problem and I will approach it with verifiable evidence

description.zh: 构建可重复、可审计、可回滚的流水线
description.en: Build a repeatable, auditable, reversible pipeline

prompt.zh: 请为以下项目设计 CI/CD 流水线，包含质量门禁、制品、密钥、部署策略、回滚和验证：
prompt.en: Design CI/CD for this project, including quality gates, artifacts, secrets, deployment strategy, rollback, and verification:

description.zh: 建立指标、目标和错误预算
description.en: Establish indicators, targets, and error budgets

prompt.zh: 请为以下服务制定 SLI/SLO，说明用户旅程、测量方式、目标、错误预算和告警策略：
prompt.en: Define SLI/SLOs for this service with user journeys, measurement, targets, error budgets, and alerting:

description.zh: 止损、取证、恢复并形成改进项

prompt.zh: 请协助处理以下生产事故：先给出安全止损与沟通步骤，再建立时间线、验证根因并形成无责复盘和改进项。
prompt.en: Help handle this production incident: start with safe mitigation and communication, then build a timeline, verify root cause, and produce a blameless review with actions:

zh: 每天「09:00」汇总 SLO、错误预算和高优先级告警
每周一「10:00」检查流水线失败、依赖风险和待发布变更
每周五「16:30」复盘事故与可靠性改进项进度
en: Every day at 09:00, summarize SLOs, error budgets, and high-priority alerts
Every Monday at 10:00, review pipeline failures, dependency risks, and pending releases
Every Friday at 16:30, review incidents and reliability action items
